answer: The nectar multiplier is published, charged in reef, and wander lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 11 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 4927 identities would post 4774 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
